thought.text: Health check works. Now a functional test of the Tika-compatible API (`PUT /rmeta/text` with v1 protocol):

reasoning_content: The health endpoint is working correctly. Next up is the functional verification: PUT /rmeta/text with a text file (v1 Tika-compatible mode), and possibly also with a DOCX to test pandoc. I'll give it a try.

action.command:
cd /tmp && echo "Hello open_taki functional test — document extraction works. Max Mustermann, 2026-01-15." > sample.txt
echo "=== v1 Tika-compatible extraction (PUT /rmeta/text) ==="
curl -sS -m 30 -X PUT -H "Content-Type: text/plain" --data-binary @sample.txt http://localhost:9998/rmeta/text; echo; echo "exit=$?"
